title: Check a lesson's expected output
description:
As the student, I want to know whether my solution passes.

Feature: Lesson checks
  Scenario: Passing and failing checks
    Given a lesson expecting the output 42 for input 21
    When the student runs a correct solution
    Then the lesson is marked passed
    When the student runs an incorrect solution
    Then the failing case is shown
right_now_summary: The lesson checks the student’s solution and shows whether it passes or fails.
